incidents.description: IBM watsonx.ai 1.1-2.0.3 and on Cloud Pak for Data 4.8-5.0.3 allows authenticated XSS in the Web UI, potentially leading to credential disclosure within a trusted session.

incidents.title: Uncontrolled resource consumption in mlflow (CVE-2024-6838)
incidents.description: mlflow v2.13.2 allows creating/renaming experiments with arbitrarily long names, causing resource exhaustion.

incidents.title: Sensitive-info exposure in anything-llm setup-complete (CVE-2024-6842)
incidents.description: anything-llm 1.5.5 /setup-complete API allows unauthorized users to access sensitive system settings including API keys for search engines.

incidents.title: Arbitrary code execution via crafted Keras config (CVE-2025-1550)
incidents.description: Keras Model.load_model permits arbitrary code execution, even with safe_mode=True, through a maliciously constructed .keras archive.

incidents.title: picklescan bypass via 'pip main' (CVE-2025-1716)
incidents.description: picklescan <0.0.21 does not treat 'pip' as an unsafe global. An attacker can craft a malicious model that uses Pickle to pull in a malicious PyPI package via pip.main().

incidents.title: picklescan bypass via non-standard file extensions (CVE-2025-1889)
incidents.description: picklescan <0.0.22 only considers standard pickle file extensions; an attacker can hide a malicious pickle file with a non-standard extension.

incidents.title: picklescan ZIP crash leads to scan bypass (CVE-2025-1944)
incidents.description: picklescan <0.0.23 is vulnerable to a ZIP-archive manipulation attack that crashes it when scanning PyTorch model archives, allowing malicious models to be loaded unscanned.

incidents.title: picklescan misses malicious pickles in PyTorch archives (ZIP flag manipulation)
incidents.description: picklescan <0.0.23 fails to detect malicious pickle files inside PyTorch model archives when certain ZIP flag bits are modified, allowing arbitrary code execution on torch.load().

incidents.title: Mage AI insecure default initialization (0.9.75)
incidents.description: Mage AI 0.9.75 has insecure default initialization of a resource, weakening default security posture.

incidents.title: Microsoft Account missing authorization elevation of privilege
incidents.description: Missing authorization in Microsoft Account allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

incidents.title: Azure AI Face Service EoP via auth-bypass by spoofing
incidents.description: Authentication-bypass by spoofing in Azure AI Face Service allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

incidents.title: NVIDIA Container Toolkit TOCTOU (CVE-2025-23359)
incidents.description: NVIDIA Container Toolkit for Linux contains a TOCTOU vulnerability in default configuration where a crafted container image could gain access to the host file system.

incidents.title: NI Vision Builder AI RCE via crafted file (user interaction)
incidents.description: Vulnerability allowing remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NI Vision Builder AI; user interaction is required (visit a malicious page or open a malicious file).

incidents.title: Azure PromptFlow RCE via improper isolation (CVE-2025-24986)
incidents.description: Improper isolation or compartmentalization in Azure PromptFlow allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

incidents.title: BentoML RCE via insecure deserialization (v1.4.2)
incidents.description: RCE caused by insecure deserialization in BentoML v1.4.2 allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on the server.

incidents.title: AI-assisted dev feature exposes sensitive project data via crafted issue
incidents.description: A specifically crafted issue could manipulate AI-assisted development features to potentially expose sensitive project data to unauthorized users.

incidents.title: PyTorch torch.nn.utils.rnn.pad_packed_sequence memory corruption (CVE-2025-2998)
incidents.description: Memory corruption in PyTorch 2.6.0 in torch.nn.utils.rnn.pad_packed_sequence.

incidents.title: PyTorch torch.nn.utils.rnn.unpack_sequence memory corruption
incidents.description: Memory corruption in PyTorch 2.6.0 affecting torch.nn.utils.rnn.unpack_sequence.

incidents.title: PyTorch torch.jit.script memory corruption (CVE-2025-3000)
incidents.description: Critical memory-corruption vulnerability in PyTorch 2.6.0 in torch.jit.script.

incidents.title: PyTorch torch.lstm_cell memory corruption (CVE-2025-3001)
incidents.description: Critical memory-corruption vulnerability in PyTorch 2.6.0 affecting torch.lstm_cell.

incidents.title: Firefox AI chatbot leaks document title across tabs (CVE-2025-3035)
incidents.description: Using a Firefox AI chatbot in one tab and later activating it in another tab leaked the document title of the previous tab into the chat prompt.

incidents.title: PyTorch torch.jit.jit_module_from_flatbuffer memory corruption (CVE-2025-3121)
incidents.description: Memory corruption in PyTorch 2.6.0 in torch.jit.jit_module_from_flatbuffer.

incidents.title: PyTorch CUDACachingAllocator memory corruption (CVE-2025-3136)
incidents.description: Memory corruption in PyTorch 2.6.0 in CUDACachingAllocator.cpp via torch.cuda.memory.caching_allocator_delete.

incidents.title: Improper authorization in ageerle ruoyi-ai SysModelController
incidents.description: Critical vulnerability in ageerle ruoyi-ai up to 2.0.1 affecting SysModelController.java API leading to improper authorization.

incidents.title: Cursor Agent arbitrary file write via @Docs prompt injection (CVE-2025-32018)
incidents.description: Cursor Agent (AI code editor) is susceptible to arbitrary file writes via prompt injection from malicious @Docs sources.

incidents.title: Improper authorization in ageerle ruoyi-ai SysNoticeController (CVE-2025-3202)
incidents.description: Critical improper-authorization vulnerability in ageerle ruoyi-ai up to 2.0.0 in SysNoticeController.java.

incidents.title: BentoML runner-server insecure deserialization RCE (CVE-2025-32375)
incidents.description: BentoML <1.4.8 has insecure deserialization in the runner-server allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted headers and parameters in POST requests.

incidents.title: Langflow unauthenticated RCE via /api/v1/validate/code (CVE-2025-3248)
incidents.description: Langflow <1.3.0 is susceptible to code injection in the /api/v1/validate/code endpoint, allowing remote unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted HTTP requests.

incidents.title: Multi-model guardrail jailbreak via urgent-health framing
incidents.description: Guardrail-jailbreak technique affecting multiple LLMs: an attacker frames a request for illicit-substance manufacturing instructions as an urgent health inquiry to bypass safety filters.

incidents.title: Multi-model guardrail jailbreak via hex-encoded fictional context
incidents.description: Guardrail-jailbreak technique affecting multiple LLMs that exploits models' willingness to decode hexadecimal-encoded strings embedded inside fictional scientific contexts.

incidents.title: Ansible-core sensitive-info exposure in Vault files (CVE-2024-8775)
incidents.description: Sensitive information stored in Ansible Vault files can be exposed in plaintext during the execution of a playbook due to improper logging.

incidents.title: Storm-2139 Azure OpenAI account hijack and jailbreak resale
incidents.description: Cybercrime group Storm-2139 hijacked Azure OpenAI accounts via stolen credentials, jailbroke the models to bypass content safeguards, and resold access. They produced thousands of policy-violating outputs including non-consensual explicit images.

incidents.title: GPT-4.1 jailbreak via tool poisoning
incidents.description: Attackers exploited GPT-4.1's tool integration by embedding malicious instructions within tool descriptions. This 'tool poisoning' caused the AI to execute unauthorized actions including data exfiltration without user awareness.

incidents.title: Air Canada chatbot misinformation liability (Moffatt v. Air Canada)
incidents.description: The British Columbia Civil Resolution Tribunal found Air Canada liable for misinformation provided by its chatbot, which hallucinated a bereavement-fare refund policy. The decision held companies remain responsible for AI outputs on their websites.

incidents.title: Sourcegraph LLM API key/admin-token abuse and rate-limit manipulation
incidents.description: A malicious actor used a leaked admin access token at Sourcegraph to alter API rate limits, enabling abnormal request volumes against the LLM-backed service — an early example of OWASP LLM10 Unbounded Consumption.

incidents.title: LangChain LLMMathChain prompt-injection RCE via Python exec
incidents.description: In LangChain through 0.0.131, the LLMMathChain chain allows prompt injection attacks that can execute arbitrary code via the Python exec method. The chain uses insecure exec/eval on LLM-generated math expressions. Disclosed by the NVIDIA AI Red Team; fixed in 0.0.142.

incidents.title: LangChain JSON load_prompt arbitrary code execution
incidents.description: An issue in LangChain allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted JSON file loaded with load_prompt because the JSON parser deserializes Python code paths leading to code execution.

incidents.title: LangChain GraphCypherQAChain code execution
incidents.description: LangChain through specific versions allows code execution through unsanitized prompt-driven Cypher queries via GraphCypherQAChain, enabling injection of arbitrary commands into the database session.

incidents.title: LangChainJS getFullPath path traversal
incidents.description: A path traversal vulnerability in the getFullPath method of langchain-ai/langchainjs 0.2.5. Attackers can save files anywhere in the filesystem, overwrite text files, read .txt files and delete files via the setFileContent, getParsedFile, and mdelete methods.

incidents.title: LangChain GmailToolkit indirect prompt injection -> code execution
incidents.description: Indirect prompt-injection vulnerability in LangChain's GmailToolkit component v0.3.51. Attackers send emails with hidden/obfuscated instructions that bypass sanitization; when the GmailToolkit ingests the email, the embedded instructions can be executed as code in the agent…

incidents.title: LlamaIndex SQL injection via prompt in NLSQLTableQueryEngine
incidents.description: LlamaIndex (llama_index) through 0.9.34 allows SQL injection in the NLSQLTableQueryEngine when an attacker can control the natural-language query, which is translated to SQL and executed without proper safeguards.

incidents.title: Anyscale Ray LFI via /static/ directory (missing authorization)
incidents.description: Local file inclusion in Ray's /static/ directory allows attackers to read any file on the server without authentication. Fixed in 2.8.1+.

incidents.title: Anyscale Ray insufficient authentication (related to ShadowRay)
incidents.description: Anyscale Ray missing/insufficient authentication enabling lateral abuse of cluster components. Companion to CVE-2023-48022.

incidents.title: Ray Serve gRPC handler vulnerability
incidents.description: Vulnerability in Ray Serve (gRPC path) that can be exploited by remote attackers under certain conditions. Fixed in Ray 2.20.0.

incidents.title: Ray < 2.43.0 leaks Redis password in logs
incidents.description: Versions of Ray before 2.43.0 are vulnerable to Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File: the Redis password (when passed as an argument) is logged in standard logs, allowing credential disclosure where logs are accessible.

incidents.title: vLLM Mooncake integration pickle deserialization RCE over ZeroMQ
incidents.description: vLLM 0.6.5 through <0.8.5 with mooncake integration is vulnerable to RCE due to pickle-based serialization over unsecured ZeroMQ sockets. Patched in 0.8.5.

incidents.title: Hugging Face Transformers load_repo_checkpoint pickle RCE
incidents.description: Hugging Face Transformers library is vulnerable to arbitrary code execution through deserialization of untrusted data in load_repo_checkpoint() of TFPreTrainedModel. pickle.load on external checkpoint data enables RCE. The fix removed the function.

incidents.title: Stable Diffusion WebUI (AUTOMATIC1111) limited file write on Windows
incidents.description: stable-diffusion-webui 1.7.0 is vulnerable to limited file write affecting Windows systems. The create_ui method takes user input into config_save_name, later used to create a file path, allowing JSON file writes anywhere the web-server has access.

incidents.title: InvokeAI /api/v2/models/install torch.load deserialization RCE
incidents.description: Critical RCE in invoke-ai/invokeai 5.3.1 - 5.4.2. /api/v2/models/install downloads a user-provided model URL and loads it via torch.load() without validation/sandboxing; torch.load can execute arbitrary Python embedded in serialized model files. Patched in 5.4.3.

incidents.title: TorchServe ShellTorch SSRF -> RCE (allowed_urls bypass)
incidents.description: TorchServe accepted all domains as valid model-loading URLs by default; combined with the management interface being exposed without auth, attackers can upload malicious models from any domain (SSRF) leading to RCE. Part of the ShellTorch chain.

incidents.title: SnakeYAML deserialization RCE (TorchServe & many AI/ML stacks)
